messages:
Maria: Sunsetting the evening — quick handoff for sunset watch. Primary: Maria (me) until 23:59 PST, Secondary: Sam. Coverage note: we have a potential gap around 02:00-04:00 UTC (no planned overlap). See checklist below. :wave:

Sam: ack — I'm online and reachable via pager + mobile.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 5319879001 - KV-eviction-surge detected on embedding-cache - P2 page created - affected endpoints: /v1/generate -> intermittent 503s

Maria: Timeline summary: 20:14 UTC we observed increased 5xx at the router. 20:16 alerts tiled. Symptoms: p95 token latency spike and elevated 503s. Preliminary signal points to concurrent cold-evictions across embedding-cache shards causing downstream retries and queueing.

Lee: I'm seeing eviction churn logs on nodes 7/8/9. Quick repro checks I ran: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=embed-cache -n prod | grep eviction | tail -n 50
redis-cli -h embed-cache-7 INFO memory
```

Kelsey: FYI I shipped a change to reduce cache TTL for bulky keys at 20:35 UTC (PR #8743) to try and lower churn, but that rollout coincided with a transient spike in 503s. Rolling back might be safer if churn continues.

Maria: Mitigations executed so far:
- 20:36 UTC: scaled dedicated-embed-pool +2 instances (manual) — autoscaler was slow to react
- 20:40 UTC: disabled prefix-eviction scheduled job (temporary)
- 20:45 UTC: rolled back PR #8743 to stop aggressive TTL changes
- 20:58 UTC: manual LRU backlog prune on node-9 using `redis-cli --scan | xargs redis-cli DEL` (low-risk targeted deletes)

Sam: Current status as of 21:05 UTC: p95 latency and error rate have returned near baseline. No new customer tickets in Zendesk for the last 30m. Monitoring shows a few amber warnings in cache-metrics but no active alerts.

Maria: Open follow-ups for next shift:
1) INFRA-546: investigate why the HPA/autoscaler lagged and missed the initial load
2) Runbook update: add a safe-mode toggle to prefix-eviction job + throttles for eviction rate
3) Postmortem trigger conditions: error-rate > 5% for > 15m -> schedule a retro if threshold met
4) Coverage: arrange secondary overlap 02:00-04:00 UTC or arrange swap

Lee: Evidence links and quick dashboards:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/evictions/kv-eviction
- Logs query: https://logs.redwood.internal/q/5319876543
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction

incident-bot: Incident 5319879001 -> RESOLVED at 21:00 UTC (mitigated, monitoring)

Kelsey: I'll take ownership of runbook edits tomorrow AM. Plan: add a safe-mode toggle and an automated autoscaler audit for underprovision events.

Maria: Handoff checklist (mark when done):
- [ ] Confirm autoscaler team response (INFRA-546)
- [x] Suppress pager for resolved incident
- [x] Update on-call calendar for potential swaps :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll be covering as secondary from 23:59 PST — Maria if you want to swap for the 02-04 UTC window please ping now and I'll confirm.

Maria: Leaving notes in INFRA-546 and the post-incident channel. If anything flares, ping @channel or call my mobile. Switching to standby — thanks all. :sleeping:
